summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.50/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.50 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 9, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 1¢ lower than a week ago, 35¢ lower than a month ago, and 67¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.37) and the highest in La Crosse ($3.68).
